detail.longDescription: I have to download multiple files (at least 400) from a website. For now, I click on the link I research on the website of the corresponding file (this manual step is mandatory, as I have to choose which file is "good" for me). But, when I click on the link, there is no direct download (and the main problem is that I would like the download to start immediately). I have multiple steps before that : click on the link click on "external windows" on the PDF file (this will open a Google Drive of the PDF file) click on "open the original" click on "download" Doing all of these steps for more than 400 files adds a lot of time. I tried with "Automator" but it cannot create shortcut or reproduce the actions for a different webpage.
